funding_reviews.availability_note: The published call opened 13 October 2026; the work programme gives 14 January 2027 at 17:00 Brussels time. The portal returned an application shell, so its live status/amendments could not be independently inspected.
funding_reviews.territory: EU/associated-country framework; Spain is an eligible member state. No specific Alhama parcel, organisation or partner is confirmed.
funding_reviews.applicants: Eligible legal entities under General Annex B; RIA normally requires three independent entities in different countries including an EU member state; topic-specific multi-actor conditions apply. CSA follows its own consortium rules.
funding_reviews.activities: Research and Innovation Action; multi-actor approach, three new living labs with 8–15 experimental sites each; distinct ecosystem research fields and portfolio rules apply.
funding_reviews.financial_summary: Indicative topic €60m, around €10m EU contribution per project, not a site grant. Lump-sum financing; permitted third-party grants up to €60,000 each are future beneficiary-run calls, not open opportunities now.
funding_reviews.verification_note: The Funding & Tenders topic page exposed only an application shell. Recover its current status and amendments through the live portal; the official work programme and REA calendar were recovered and reviewed.
